Title supplied. Manuscript on silk. Brush-and-ink and watercolor. Oriented with north toward the upper right. Relief shown pictorially. Bird's-eye view. Shows the sites of the 13 Ming emperors' tombs and their environs, including the Great Wall and its strategic gates near Beijing. Originally mounted as a handscroll. Hummel purchase 1930, no. 17. Includes descriptive notes. Perspective map not drawn to scale. Available also through the Library of Congress Web site as a raster image.
